summary: Iter53 verified realtime proctor SSE, Bank Soal CRUD + ACL + UI, 5-digit face-confirm validation, and pretty Excel exports across 9 endpoints. Backend: 25/25 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_realtime_bank_face_excel.py (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter53.xml). Covered: (a) /api/question-bank list/from-exam dedupe/use increments used_count/delete/siswa 403; (b) GET /api/exams/{eid}/live shape + 403 siswa; GET /api/exams/{eid}/live/stream returns text/event-stream with 'retry: 2000' + 'event: live' within <2s, siswa 403; (c) /api/attendance/face-confirm now rejects 4-digit (422) and 6-digit (422) and accepts 5-digit payload, backend prompt mentions '5 angka NIS'; (d) 9 pretty exports (users/users-staff/attendance/attendance_week/social-fund/inventory/ppdb/library/piket) all return valid xlsx with LAPORAN/REKAP/DAFTAR title in row 2 and 2F6FD6 blue header (row 6, or row 5 for weekly matrix format); exam export has both 'Nilai Ujian' + 'Analisis Butir' sheets; /api/users/import/template still plain (header in row 1 starts with 'Nama'). Frontend (Playwright): Live Proctor opens from exam-live-{id}, proctor-connection[data-mode='live'] after SSE connects, 2 tiles rendered without manual refresh. ExamAnalysis modal shows analysis-select-good + analysis-save-bank + analysis-selected-count (updates to 1 after clicking analysis-select-1). Exam editor exam-open-bank -> bank-picker-modal with bank-search/subject-filter/type-filter present; 2 bank items visible, selecting enables bank-use-button. Piket page (/piket, super_admin): 13/14 testids present (piket-mine-steps missing because super_admin has no scheduled shift - conditional render, acceptable). piket-create-button opens modal with piket-teacher-select + piket-save-button. Week view: 7 day rows + 6 add buttons rendered.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <...>' originating around DashboardLayout.jsx line 100 / an <option> element. Cosmetic console noise, doesn't affect rendering.

action_items: (low) Clean up the <span>-in-<option> (or similar) nesting in DashboardLayout.jsx:100 to silence the React hydration warning seen on every page load.

(info) piket-mine-steps is only rendered when the current user has an upcoming shift. Confirm this is the intended behaviour; otherwise show a stepper placeholder to make the review spec reproducible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6587-6605 exam_live_stream polls Mongo every 1s per client with no shared pub/sub. For a classroom of 30+ students x multiple proctors this will linearly multiply DB load. Consider a single ticker per exam using asyncio.Event / change streams.
server.py:6516 _bank_scope merges dscope() twice for super_admin (dscope on top-level and inside the dict). Harmless but confusing; drop the second spread for the super_admin branch.

server.py:6537 duplicate detection only compares exact normalized text ('q'.strip().lower()). Will keep near-duplicates with minor whitespace / punctuation differences. Fine for v1 but worth revisiting (fingerprint on alnum-only).

LiveProctor.jsx:99 EventSource is constructed with { withCredentials: true } which only forwards cookies. If the user authenticated via Bearer token only (no cookie), the stream will 401 and silently fall through to polling. Logging the mode='polling' fallback already helps; consider surfacing a one-time toast.

DigitPad.jsx:8 the auto-submit effect fires on every v change; it's gated by length===LEN but still re-runs onSubmit if parent re-renders without resetting v. Reset v after onSubmit to guarantee single-shot submission.
server.py is now 6985 lines - exam/vortex-guard block still a strong refactor candidate (also flagged in iter50/51/52).
